payload.rationale: Service 'catalog-api' in namespace 'proofix-case-03' is configured with targetPort 8080, while the backend pods run NGINX listening on port 8081 (named 'catalog-http'). Patching the Service's targetPort to 8081 restores connectivity between the Service endpoints and backend pod containers.
payload.rollback_trigger: HTTP 5xx error rate >= 0.001 or p95 latency >= 200ms after applying the patch.

success_criteria.description: HTTP requests to catalog-api service succeed with HTTP 200, HTTP 5xx error rate remains < 0.001, and p95 latency remains < 200ms across 3 consecutive windows.

critical_claims.claim: Service 'catalog-api' in namespace 'proofix-case-03' was configured with targetPort 8080 targeting port 80.
Endpoints 'catalog-api' routed traffic to pod IPs 10.42.0.35 and 10.42.0.36 on port 8080.
The backend pods for 'catalog-api' are configured with containerPort 8081 (named 'catalog-http') and are running and ready.
The NGINX configuration in ConfigMap 'catalog-nginx' specifies the server listens on port 8081.
Service 'catalog-api' was patched to align the targetPort with the backend container listening port.
Subsequent SLO samples verified zero error rate and healthy status across three consecutive 10-second windows.

closure.summary: Incident CASE-03 was caused by a targetPort mismatch on the 'catalog-api' Service, which routed traffic to port 8080 while the backend NGINX pods listened on port 8081 as defined in their container spec and ConfigMap. Patching the Service targetPort resolved the routing failure and restored SLO compliance.
